notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - July 10/20
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

Some different news today! Since February 2019, we've been sharing a Dev Update, every single week. 

After over [b]70 updates[/b], we realize that this probably isn't the best way to[b] "show"[/b] you what we're working on. Not going to lie, sometimes it looked more like a shopping list instead of exciting features. 

So, we want to bring you a more visual, impactful way to see new features. We're players too, so we want to bring something that's a bit more "wow", and save the features that we're not [i]quite[/i] ready to share yet, and hope they will surprise you. 🙂

This is why we've decided to [b]stop the Weekly Dev Updates[/b] as they are now, which don't exactly reflect what we're working on.

We'll always stay in touch, and keep you updated, with the new concept we'll share here soon!

See you soon,

The Norsfell Team 🗻


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f0b8542352a2e2f462765f7cb78d76a6fbb07a34.gif[/img]

Another aspect of the game that we're working on is making the world feel more "full"- this is one of our focuses this week along with new weapon spells. We've been working on new Camps to add to our swamp biome, the Land of Pools.

[b]Is there any weapon spell you wish to see in the game later on?[/b]

Let us know which ones! If you haven't played the game yet, our weapon spells are based around elemental attacks, so for example, a Dark skill would come from a Dark sword, and its color would be specific to the element (Dark = purple). When fighting, you'll also find opposite elements have better damage against each other, so if you're fighting our Fire Giant (Hàlogi) you'd definitely want to pick up an ice weapon.

See you next week!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - October 16/19
notes.notes:
Hey! Our first Dev-Updates on Steam have begun! We're going to be using Steam Community more often, and that includes having our development updates here.

To get you up to speed - we had our most recent Open Beta from September 5 to 10th, and we've been working on the next big update ever since then.

The focus last week was mostly on Creatures, as we want more variation in not only how they look, but how they counter you, including casting new spells and critical hit abilities. 

Last week, we worked on: 

🏕️ - Creating new Land of Pools Camps
💥 - Adding Explosive Barrels in Camps
🍀 - Creating New Icons for New Materials
🖌️ - Texturing different Leveled Up Creatures
📥 - Integrating Assets of Leveled Up Creatures
🏹 - Animating new Projectile Spells for Elf Archers
🛡️ - Adding AI Behaviors to Projectile and Shield Users
💣 - Creating remaining Spells for all Leveled Up Creatures
👿 - Modelling different Leveled Up Mini Trolls and Vikings
👻 - Drawing different Leveled Up Unsunken Javelin Vikings
⚒️ - Fixing various Bugs related to Menus, Day Cycle and Servers

Let us know what you're looking forward to the most!
Cheers! 💜
